title: Glossier You Eau de Parfum Travel Spray
descriptionHtml:
✓ Layerable Scent✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Unisex/Genderless Scent✓ Warm & Spicy Scent✓ Vegan
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy

Scent Type: Warm & Sheer

Key Notes: Pink Pepper, Iris, Ambrox

Fragrance Description: The ultimate personal fragrance. A skin-scent enhancer, this Eau de Parfum smells different on everyone. It has bright, spicy top notes of pink pepper that are met with a sweet, warm center from ambrette seeds and smooth, salty ambrox. It’s balanced with earthy iris. Mostly it smells like you: soft, warm, and familiar.

About the Bottle: The bottle is an objet d’art in its own right. It is crafted in-house at Glossier, it has the real thumbprint indent of the designer. So just like the scent, the bottle of Glossier You is unfinished. It needs you hold it, to complete it.

About t
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a longer-lasting, stronger scent. 

-After applying, avoid rubbing or dabbing skin. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly. 

-If you prefer placing fragrance on your wrists, be sure to reapply after frequent hand-washing, as this tends to rinse off the scent. 

-Replace fragrance after 12 months. Expired perfumes more than a year old lose the integrity of the original scent.


Eau de Toilette or Eau de Parfum?:
The difference lies in the volume of perfume oil. While EDT contains five to nine percent, EDP contains more, usually eight to 14 percent. EDPs, therefore, last longer and smell more intense.

Ingredients+
Alcohol Denat., Fragrance/Parfum, Water/Aqua/Eau, Hydroxycitronellal, Farnesol, Limonene.
